effects.summary: Reduces federal deficits by about $1.5 trillion over 2023–2033, mostly through caps on discretionary spending; also suspends the debt limit through January 1, 2025.
Argues the realized savings will likely be smaller than CBO's official score because of reported side agreements that loosen the spending caps.
effects.source_name: Committee for a Responsible Federal Budget (fiscal-hawk think tank)
